name: com.onelobby.unity
description: OneLobby for Unity: lobbies with join codes, WebRTC peer-to-peer data channels, lockstep or raw netcode, text chat and voice. Thin Unity plumbing (UnityTransport, UnityVoiceAudio, OneLobbyRunner) over the engine-agnostic OneLobby.Core.

samples.description: One script with an IMGUI menu: Host, Join by code, send a reliable message, hold V to talk.
